verses.en: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights.
verses.sm: Ia vivii atu ia te ia le la ma le masina; ia vivii atu ia te ia outou fetu uma o loo fepulafi mai.

verses.en: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.
verses.sm: Ia vivii atu ia te ia le lagi o lagi,

verses.en: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
verses.sm: ma vai o loo i luga o le lagi. Ia latou vivii atu i le suafa o le ALII;

verses.en: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.
verses.sm: aua o ia na fetalai ane, ona faia lava lea. Na ia faatumauina foi i latou e faavavau faavavau lava;

verses.en: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for he commanded, and they were created.
verses.sm: na faia e ia le tulafono, e le solia lava. Ia vivii atu i le ALII ai

verses.en: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.
verses.sm: le lalolagi o tanimo ma mea loloto uma; o le afi ma le uato“a, o le kiona ma le ausa;

verses.en: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:
verses.sm: o le matagi e afa ai, o loo faia lana afioga. O mauga tetele,

verses.en: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
verses.sm: ma mauga iti uma lava; o laau e fua mai, ma arasi uma lava.

verses.en: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
verses.sm: O manu feai, ma manu vaefa uma; o mea fetolofi, ma manu felelei.

verses.en: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:
verses.sm: 12 13 14 n A w SALAMO 148, 149, O tupu o le lalolagi, ma nuu atoa uma lava;

verses.en: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:
verses.sm: o alii, ma faamasino uma o le lalolagi. O taulelea atoa ma teine, o toeaina atoa ma tama.

verses.en: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:
verses.sm: Ia latou vivii atu i le suafa o le ALII;

verses.en: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
verses.sm: aua ua na o lona suafa e mamalu; o lona viiga ua sili lea i le lalolagi atoa ma le lagi.

verses.en: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.sm: Ua faarnaualugaina foi e ia le nifo o lona nuu, o le viiga o ona tagata amio Atua uma; o le fanauga a Isaraelu, o le nuu o loo latalata ia te ia. Ia outou vivii atu i le ALII.
